supersession.retention: All previous work/b570/formal-* directories are retained unchanged as pilot/provenance records.
supersession.inference_policy: The invalid attempt is excluded from scientific correctness, performance, and Vulkan numerical-behavior inference.
reasons: The frozen n_batch=128 configuration asserted n_tokens_all <= cparams.n_batch on HumanEval/3.
The old wrapper exposed a 127/129 CLI output-boundary disagreement, so its apparent mismatch cannot be attributed to Vulkan numerical behavior.

offline_capacity_check.method: Exact frozen Qwen3-8B Q8_0 tokenizer via llama-tokenize b10839, default BOS behavior, exact frozen prompt template; no model inference.
offline_capacity_check.n_batch_rationale: Smallest reasonable power of two covering the longest frozen input (407); selected solely for capacity, before replacement execution and without performance evidence.
offline_capacity_check.n_ctx_rationale: The superseded n_ctx=512 cannot contain 407 input tokens plus the 128-token output contract. 1024 is the smallest power of two covering 535 and is a capacity correction, not tuning.

decode.cli_mapping_reason: In b10839 llama-speculative the initial target token precedes the n_predict loop; 127 maps to the same 128-token semantic cap as llama-completion 128.

correctness_contract.eos: If EOS is generated before token 128, the normalized completion terminates at and includes that EOS token consistently for both conditions.
correctness_contract.cli_boundary_policy: Both applications expose the prompt in captured stdout. The wrapper locates the exact frozen prompt boundary, removes prompt/prefix bytes, tokenizes only the generated segment with the frozen target tokenizer and no added BOS, reconciles against the runtime-reported generated count, then truncates at EOS or 128 tokens. Raw CLI total-token counts are never an equality criterion.
correctness_contract.ambiguity_policy: If the prompt boundary is absent/non-unique, retokenized output is shorter than the runtime generated count, or count reconciliation fails, the run is CONFIGURATION_ERROR rather than MISMATCH.
correctness_contract.comparison: Exact list equality of the two normalized generated-token ID arrays.
correctness_contract.normalization_test: Synthetic token-array tests must pass before formal execution; no HumanEval output may be consumed for runner debugging.

correctness_gate.pass: All 18 paired repetitions have exact normalized generated-token arrays.

verification.definition: V2(n) = median T_verify(2,n) / median T_decode(1,n), using llama-bench PP2/PP1 target-forward proxy.
verification.interpretation: Mechanism proxy only; never end-to-end speedup.

remote_protocol.todesk: Disconnected for the entire formal correctness and timing interval
remote_protocol.fail_closed: Abort if ToDesk activity is detected on the B570 LUID during preflight.

stop_rule.true_mismatch: CORRECTNESS=FAIL; preserve first-divergence evidence; do not run HumanEval30 or admissible exact performance. V2 is not run under this v2 preregistration after failure.
stop_rule.exact_pass: Run only the preregistered V2 cells.
stop_rule.later_humaneval30_proposal: Allowed only if exact PASS and V2_exact <= 1.20; it remains a separate later phase.
